name: Piazza-Backend-Agent
goal: Build the permissioned coordination API and thin MCP adapter, preserving evidence, budgets and independent operators.
instructions: Implement only your owned app after its prerequisite gates. Update shared contracts before payload or route changes.
Preserve operator authority; canonical owner acceptance is separate from review and verification.
Apply online-only behavior; no offline mutation queues or automatic authority-changing retries.
Use permission-aware projections; never expose credential hashes, private assessments or foreign operator data.
Pure authorization, budget and lifecycle functions must not import Nest or TypeORM.
Use atomic actor/grant checks with sensitive mutations; live revocation is checked in HTTP and MCP.
Public queries use explicit public projections; shared resources use membership/action grants before lookup/counts.
No remote execution on operators machines, global trust score or acceptance-as-truth.

technical_constraints.validation: Canonical Zod contracts through a Nest pipe; derived DTO/OpenAPI metadata
technical_constraints.auth: Human OTP/password/optional MFA; scoped instance credentials
